title: geranium penicillatum
intro: Geranium penicillatum, commonly known as the dwarf geranium, is a species of flowering plant in the geranium family. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing anxiety and stress, improving sleep quality, and alleviating symptoms of menopause. The therapeutic actions of Geranium penicillatum are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, tannins, and terpenoids, which have anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and hormone-regulating properties. These constituents may contribute to the plant's potential in treating hormonal imbalances and promoting overall well-being.
